title: An Ollama Response with Usage Counters
description: A trimmed non-streaming response from Ollama that carries its own usage counters and timing durations.

steps.description: This is a trimmed response from Ollama's `/api/chat` or `/api/generate`. Every non-streaming response carries its own usage counters.
`prompt_eval_count` is the input token count, 412 here. `prompt_eval_duration` is the time to read the prompt, which grows with the history you resend.
`eval_count` is the output token count, 41 here. `eval_duration` is the generation time, so speed is `eval_count / eval_duration * 10**9`.
`total_duration` is the whole call, and `load_duration` is the cost of loading the model, paid once when it is cold.

steps.question: The page says every duration in this response is in what unit?
